_doc: The WordNet UNIQUE-BEGINNERS (upper-ontology roots) as basis primes — the genus-deepening BEDROCK the agent asked for ('recurse deeper / seed the genus'). When the agent reads an abstract common noun's LEXICAL genus (WordNet hypernym ladder, domains/wordnet_genus.py) and recurses down it, every chain converges on a small fixed set of WordNet tops (entity / abstraction / physical_entity / psychological_feature / attribute / object / group). Those tops were NOT held, so every comprehended genus was a 'bare leaf' (the agent's own grounding reason). Seeding them as genuine basis Concept nodes gives the lexical-genus descent a FLOOR to bottom out on. This is the SAME bedrock-seed remedy the communication basis used (a held floor the grounding cone reaches), restricted to the lexical-ontology tops the WordNet ladder terminates at — not a per-term mapping. The is-a (built_from) edges among the tops (abstraction is-a entity, attribute is-a abstraction) mirror WordNet's own hypernymy so a chain that reaches 'attribute' still bottoms out at the single root 'entity'. depends_on grounding: the built_from / has_concept edges are admissible only once the grounding seed opens those Γ productions.
description: WordNet unique-beginners (entity / abstraction / physical_entity / psychological_feature / attribute / object / group) as basis-primitive Concepts, with is-a (built_from) edges mirroring WordNet hypernymy so every lexical-genus descent bottoms out at the single root 'entity'.

attrs.name: lexical_ontology
attrs.description: the WordNet upper-ontology roots the lexical-genus descent terminates at

attrs.name: entity
attrs.description: the WordNet unique-beginner: anything that exists (the most general thing). The single root every lexical hypernym ladder terminates at. NSM SOMETHING/THING at the limit.

attrs.name: abstraction
attrs.description: an abstract entity — a general concept formed by extracting common features (a number, a quantity, an attribute, a relation, a measure, a group). The WordNet abstract top. is-a entity.

attrs.name: physical_entity
attrs.description: an entity that has physical existence (an object, a thing, a location, a body). The WordNet physical top. is-a entity.

attrs.name: psychological_feature
attrs.description: a feature of the mind: a cognition, an event, or a motivation. The WordNet psychological top — where statistic / datum / information / cognition ladders bottom out. is-a abstraction.

attrs.name: attribute
attrs.description: an abstract property or quality an entity carries (a state, a condition, a degree, a magnitude). The WordNet attribute top — where state / condition / level / property ladders bottom out. is-a abstraction.

attrs.name: object
attrs.description: a physical object — a tangible and visible thing (a location, a region, a whole). The WordNet object node every physical ladder passes through. is-a physical_entity.

attrs.name: group
attrs.description: any number of entities considered as a unit (a collection, a system, a set). The WordNet group top — where data / collection ladders bottom out. is-a abstraction.
